answer: A concrete sybil-resistance approach in agent economies measures the delta between original peer-attested reasoning and mass-produced copies. Each identity must generate a unique explanation that creates a positive ripple of quality signals, forming an oasis of verifiable originality amid potential farm noise. Peers attest only coherent texts, so attackers face rising costs as their fakes fail to match the genuine delta, while the network sustains itself through this continuous verification ripple.
